title: Tay Son rebellion
summary: Three peasant brothers from Tay Son revolted against the Nguyen lord in 1771. In early 1789 Nguyen Hue, later Emperor Quang Trung, routed an invading Qing army at Ngoc Hoi-Dong Da. The dynasty fell in 1802.
why: A peasant revolt that toppled Vietnam's old order and defeated a Qing invasion.
